about.title: About Us
about.introText: ASSOCIATION KESKESE MILASH NETHERLANDS aims to bring our community together, addressing challenges and promoting social justice, equality, and well-being. Established with trustworthiness and practicality, our association is dedicated to upholding principles of integrity, transparency, accountability, and responsibility.
about.heritageText: Keskese is an ancient archaeological site, and the name of the first civic association in history. Our association carries this historic name to honor our roots and the legacy of unity and civic responsibility that defines our heritage.
about.missionVisionText: To create a supportive and united community by fostering social justice, equality, and well-being among our members. We envision a thriving Keskese Milash Community in the Netherlands, connected by shared values, cultural pride, and mutual support.
